## Intro
This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to retrieve data from the BIA (Bioelectrical Impedance Analysis) subsystem of a Teslasuit device. The page is structured to help developers understand the process of initializing the Teslasuit API, connecting to a device, configuring the BIA subsystem, and streaming data.

## Code for BIA data streaming
````python
from teslasuit_sdk import ts_api

# Channels to measure — indices correspond to physical electrode pairs on the suit
BIA_CHANNELS = [1, 3, 7, 9, 12]

# Frequency sweep parameters passed to set_streaming_config
BIA_START_FREQ_HZ = 24000  # starting frequency of the impedance sweep in Hz
BIA_FREQ_STEP     = 1      # step size between consecutive frequency points
BIA_SAMPLE_COUNT  = 1000   # total number of frequency steps to sweep

def main():
    print("Initializing Teslasuit API...")
    api = ts_api.TsApi()  # create the central API object

    print("Waiting for a Teslasuit device to connect...")
    device = api.get_device_manager().get_or_wait_last_device_attached()

    print("Accessing the BIA subsystem...")
    bia = device.bia  # BIA subsystem measures tissue electrical impedance

    print("Setting up streaming configuration...")
    # Configure which channels to sweep and the frequency range before starting
    bia.set_streaming_config(BIA_CHANNELS, BIA_START_FREQ_HZ, BIA_FREQ_STEP, BIA_SAMPLE_COUNT)

    print("Starting BIA data streaming...")
    bia.start_streaming()

    try:
        while True:
            data = bia.get_data_on_ready()  # blocks until a full sweep is ready
            print("Number of channels:", data.number_of_channels)

            for channel in data.channels:
                print("Channel index:", channel.channel_index)

                for freq in channel.frequencies:
                    # Each frequency point contains a complex impedance value Z = R + jX
                    print("Frequency:", freq.frequency)
                    print("Real part:", freq.complex_number.real_value)       # resistance (R)
                    print("Imaginary part:", freq.complex_number.im_value)   # reactance (X)

    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("Stopping BIA streaming...")
        bia.stop_streaming()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

Accessing the BIA subsystem...
